nodes.label: At-least-once delivery guarantee
nodes.definition: Guarantees that a message is delivered at least once, but maybe more. Implemented via retries until acknowledgement.

nodes.label: Exactly-once delivery guarantee
nodes.definition: Guarantees that a message is delivered once and no more. Achieved by combining at-least-once retries with duplicate filtering via idempotence.

nodes.label: At-most-once delivery guarantee
nodes.definition: Guarantees that a message is delivered either once or not at all, achieved by sending once and never retrying.

nodes.label: Kafka idempotent producer
nodes.definition: Enabled via enable.idempotence=true; assigns unique key (producer ID + sequence number) to each message so broker can drop replayed ones. Default since Kafka 3.0.0.

nodes.label: Kafka acks=all setting
nodes.definition: All in-sync replicas must acknowledge before the send completes, ensuring durable write. Default since Kafka 3.0.0.

nodes.label: Kafka delivery.timeout.ms
nodes.definition: Upper bound on a single send operation including all internal retries. Critical to prevent application-level retries after Kafka internal retries complete. Default 120000ms.

nodes.label: KafkaConfig (producer side)
nodes.definition: Producer configuration with acks=all, idempotence enabled, unlimited retries via Kafka-level at-least-once.

nodes.label: KafkaConfig (consumer side)
nodes.definition: Consumer configuration with auto-commit disabled and AckMode.MANUAL_IMMEDIATE for manual offset commit after successful processing.

nodes.label: LanguagePreferenceProducer
nodes.definition: Wraps KafkaTemplate.send() with Resilience4j @Retry and @CircuitBreaker (instance name languagePreferenceProducer). Falls back to dead-letter store when circuit opens.

nodes.label: LanguagePreferenceConsumer
nodes.definition: Consumes messages with onMessage() calling process() then ack.acknowledge(). Rethrows on exception without acking; DefaultErrorHandler retries then routes to DLT.

nodes.label: LanguagePreferenceController
nodes.definition: Exposes POST /language-preferences endpoint, returns 202 Accepted immediately (fire-and-forget to producer).

nodes.label: Circuit breaker pattern
nodes.definition: Independent Resilience4j @CircuitBreaker instances protect against cascading failure. Producer fallback routes to dead-letter store when circuit opens.

nodes.label: Resilience4j retry
nodes.definition: Application-layer retry on both producer and consumer, configured for 3 attempts with 1s fixed wait. Retries on any Exception.

nodes.label: Dead-letter topic (DLT)
nodes.definition: Messages that exhaust DefaultErrorHandler retries are routed to language-preferences.DLT rather than silently dropped.

nodes.label: Manual offset commit
nodes.definition: AckMode.MANUAL_IMMEDIATE commits the offset only after process() succeeds. Crash before ack.acknowledge() causes redelivery, not loss.

nodes.label: Producer idempotence boundary (per-session)
nodes.definition: After producer restart, assigned new PID. Any unacked message sent before crash is resent with new PID, so broker cannot recognize it as duplicate. Idempotence is per-session, not durable.

nodes.label: DefaultErrorHandler
nodes.definition: Kafka listener container layer error handling with FixedBackOff(1s, 2 attempts). Routes exhausted retries to dead-letter topic independently of application retry.

nodes.label: Resilience4j circuit breaker (languagePreferenceProducer)
nodes.definition: Circuit breaker for producer: 50% failure threshold, 80% slow call threshold (2s), 30s wait in open state, COUNT_BASED window size 10, 3 half-open calls.

nodes.label: Resilience4j circuit breaker (languagePreferenceConsumer)
nodes.definition: Circuit breaker for consumer: 50% failure threshold, 30s wait in open state, COUNT_BASED window size 10.

nodes.label: Resilience4j retry (languagePreferenceProducer)
nodes.definition: Retry configuration for producer: 3 max attempts, 1s fixed wait, retries on any Exception.

nodes.label: Resilience4j retry (languagePreferenceConsumer)
nodes.definition: Retry configuration for consumer: 3 max attempts, 1s fixed wait, retries on any Exception.

nodes.definition: Reference table for producer configuration: acks, enable.idempotence, retries, delivery.timeout.ms, max.in.flight.requests.per.connection.

nodes.definition: Reference table for consumer configuration: enable.auto.commit, auto.offset.reset, AckMode.

nodes.label: Delivery guarantee layering
nodes.definition: At-least-once enforced at two independent layers: Kafka broker protocol (producer) and manual offset management (consumer). Resilience4j adds application-level retry and circuit breaking.

nodes.label: Timeout and retry failure mode
nodes.definition: Application retry may duplicate messages if first attempt times out internally but still succeeds. Mitigation: keep delivery.timeout.ms <= application timeout, or gate retry on future completion.

nodes.label: Exception on send failure mode
nodes.definition: Producer may throw exception even though message sent (network timeout, future failure, etc.). May indicate configuration problem. Check acks, retries, delivery.timeout.ms, max.in.flight.requests.

nodes.label: Boundaries after restart failure mode
nodes.definition: After crash, producer gets new PID. Unacked message resent with new PID — unrecognized as duplicate. Idempotence per-session, not durable.

nodes.label: Duplicate producer processes failure mode
nodes.definition: Multiple producer instances have different PIDs. Broker deduplicates per-PID, so each sends own messages. Can cause duplicates if same event published by multiple instances.

nodes.label: language-preferences Kafka topic
nodes.definition: Main topic where LanguagePreferenceProducer publishes events. Consumed by LanguagePreferenceConsumer.

nodes.label: language-preferences.DLT dead-letter topic
nodes.definition: Dead-letter topic for messages that exhaust DefaultErrorHandler retries. Routes failed messages separately.
